about_the_game:
The demo version of Rest in Peace will present scenes filled with various sprites and ghosts, skill constructions that combine strategy and luck, and thrilling battles that will get your heart racing.
The following showcased content will all be vividly and comprehensively presented in this demo version.

·Scene: The Ruins of a Town Infested with Ghosts

The demo version is set against the backdrop of a forest town plagued by abnormal phenomena. It is filled with characteristic monsters from Chinese ghost legends, immersing players in a stylized and eerie world.

·Skills: Diverse Yin-spell Skills with Diverse Categories

Sixteen basic skills are available in the demo version, divided into five major categories: Metal, Water, Fire, Earth, and Physical Damage. Each skill provides a different attacking experience, and each category of skills has its own unique mechanism. Players can freely choose different skills to create their own exclusive combat style and form a unique fighting approach.

·Enhancement: Skill Construction Combining Strategy and Luck

In the demo version, more than 60 enhanced Stones and enhanced Sacrifices are available. They can be combined from multiple angles and aspects to enhance combat output and survival endurance. Once a perfect combination is achieved, it can produce a dazzling effect, and with just a few words, the ghosts will be wiped out.

·Battle: Thrilling and Heart-Pounding

Players need to withstand the pressure of the wave of ghosts while dealing with various abnormal events. At the same time, the random mechanism of the bosses in the game makes it impossible for players to predict which furious Ghost King they will encounter. The game focuses on being tense, exciting, and full of unpredictable changes. Every victory will bring a great sense of accomplishment.

·Are you ready to take on the challenge?

Everyone hopes for a better afterlife, but the obsessions of this life cannot be forgotten! Now that you have reached the Yin-Yang Path, invite the guest to the funeral and rest in peace!

short_description: Rest in Peaceis a roguelike adventure game set in a Chinese ghostly world. The demo version features one level, 16 Yin-spell skills, and over 60 enhanced Stones and Sacrifices. Players can mix skills freely, customize upgrades, and face basic combat challenges.

English*, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Japanese*
*languages with full audio support
